notes.title: SimplePlanes Update and Steam Sale
notes.notes:
Today we are an releasing our final update for SimplePlanes. Release notes are [url=https://www.simpleplanes.com/Blog/View/1829113/v1-12-200-beta-is-now-available]here[/url]. We had a few small features and several bug fixes that have accumulated in our repo so we decided to finish them up and push out a final update before sailing away to the next project(s). This will be our last update for SimplePlanes, unless we have any critical issues that pop up, but hey that doesn't mean the story ends here!

You might ask [b]"is the next major project SimplePlanes 2?"[/b] Great question! That's a very strong contender and there are other ideas that we are very excited about as well. The team has been focusing on researching and developing core technologies that can be used in future games. 

Today we are also releasing an update for Juno: New Origins along with a collaboration with [b][url=https://simplerockets.com/u/Linx]@Linx[/url][/b] bringing his amazing KSP mod [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yz3LtfReBnU]Parallax[/url][/b] to Juno with improved performance and visuals.

To celebrate all of this we are going to offer a week long discount to all of our titles on Steam, so if you have been thinking of getting the original [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/343090/SimpleRockets/]SimpleRockets[/url][/b] or [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/870200/Juno_New_Origins/]Juno: New Origins[/url][/b], now it is the time!

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/878399737898881104/1155922932585988147/Jundriscount.png[/img]

These discounts apply on top of the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9556/Aerospace_Engineer/]Aerospace Engineer bundle[/url][/b], so if you want both [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/870200/Juno_New_Origins/]Juno[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/397340/SimplePlanes/]SimplePlanes[/url][/b] or just one of them and you already own the other, you can get them with an extra 15% discount.

As always, thanks for playing!

[i]Cover image credit: @Rafalemmm ([url=https://www.simpleplanes.com/a/k7bg2E/A-4-Skyhawk-Mig-17-scheme]aircraft[/url])[/i]
